title: Surat's chain of supply
body: Surat in Gujarat is known as a textile hub and has one of Asia's oldest textile markets. Raw cotton reaches Surat through cotton mandis from nearby states such as Maharashtra and from other parts of Gujarat. In thousands of factories, the cotton is woven on power looms, dyed in processing units and finished into fabric, sarees and ready-made garments. At each stage the product moves through a market: one for woven fabric, one for dyed fabric and one for finished products. The manufacturing units then trade the finished goods in the wholesale market. From there, wholesalers send the products to small shopkeepers and big retail stores across the country and abroad. They also find out how much product the retailers will need.
